issues.description: Constructor parameter labels/order for Course are inconsistent between the problem statement/template and the solution. The problem statement demonstrates initializing a Course using labels in the order Course(name: ..., instructor: ..., ratings: ...). The template declares the initializer as init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (matching the example). The solution, however, declares the initializer as init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]) (swapping the first two parameter labels). Although Swift callers using labeled arguments can pass parameters in any order, the differing declaration in the solution disagrees with the problem hint and the template and may confuse students who compare the template, the problem example, and the reference solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Unify the Course initializer signature across artifacts. Best fix: change the solution initializer to init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) so parameter labels match the problem statement's example and the template. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to use the solution's parameter labels if that was intentional. Keep labels consistent to avoid student confusion.
